Who writes the guides? | Our Australian-Thai team, which has run island trips on Koh Samui and Koh Phangan since 2006, writes and checks every guide. The same people handle bookings, pickups and daily WhatsApp questions, so most topics come straight from what guests ask us. Pages carry the team byline, and named authors appear where a team member agrees to be named.
How often are prices checked? | Prices, fees and booking pages are reviewed every month, event and party dates every week on Monday, and visa and law pages monthly and on the day a rule changes. Every price carries its year, for example 1,450 THB for the 2026 Pig Island speedboat tour, and fact boxes show the date they were last verified.
Are your guides sponsored? | No. No business can pay to be listed, ranked or described on this site, and we do not link to other tour operators or booking sites. We are a tour business and our guides link to the trips we sell, which we say openly, but beaches, restaurants and sights are chosen on merit and downsides are always included.
How do I report a mistake? | Send the page link and what is wrong to WhatsApp +66 63 704 0888 or to the email address on our Contact page. We check the point against a primary source such as a government page or an operator timetable. If you are right, we correct the page, update its date and, for important changes, add a short note saying what changed.
Do you use AI to write content? | We use software tools, including AI writing assistants, to help draft and structure pages and check consistency. Every fact is then checked against official or primary sources, and our team reviews and approves each page before it is published. Tools never write reviews, invent first-hand experiences or make up prices or dates.
Where do the photos on your site come from? | We use photos taken by our own team and crews on our trips first. Where we use stock photos, they are licensed and credited where the licence requires, and partner photos are used only with written permission. We use no watermarked or copied images and no photos of public figures, and every photo shows the actual place or trip it illustrates.
